summary: Controller default bootstrap username is root (was admin); appliance console and deploy handoff login match. API impact: existing contract — LoginRequest.username unchanged; default seed and examples updated.

guide.reason: Operator sign-in and console login instructions now use root instead of admin for Controller.

api.reason: POST /api/v1/session still takes a free-form username; only the default first-admin seed, OpenAPI examples, and handoff login username changed to root.

state.reason: Administrator accounts are Controller-scoped; the bootstrap username is stored in the Controller admins table.
state.record: Controller SQLite admins row seeded from -admin-username (default root). Fresh Controllers recover nothing from Core for this credential; existing Controllers keep their seeded username.

verification.method: go test ./internal/controller ./internal/localcore; python3 -m unittest tests.test_appliance_build; python3 scripts/generate_api.py --check.
